native_observation.additional_observed_error: orchestrator_helper_incomplete: setup helper exited successfully before setup completed
native_observation.inference_limit: The logs establish reported login/setup failures. They do not establish which password update, home, process or overlapping interval caused each failure, nor whether SetErrorMode changed the reported error.

source_causal_chain.observation: Both setup entry points use fixed local machine account names. SETUP_FLIGHTS is process-local and keyed by the complete serialized payload; distinct homes/roots do not join one flight.

Full provisioning generates two new passwords. NetUserAdd failure enters NetUserSetInfo level 1003; successful passwords are stored in that home with DPAPI. This changes shared local account state, not a home-scoped identity.
Credentials are loaded from a specific home. Refresh deletes that home credential file and requests provisioning again.
An eligible logon failure refreshes and retries once. There is no authority retaining account generation from credential read/provisioning through CreateProcessWithLogonW.

Remote exec-server harness instances have independent TempDir CODEX_HOME values. The local test caller resolves its process home via SandboxManager; it is not claimed that every local test has a fresh home.
The resolved host CODEX_HOME is passed through wrapper arguments before the child environment is cleared.

source_admitted_schedule_inference: A provisions fixed account password pA and saves it in home A.
B provisions the same fixed account with a distinct password pB and saves it in home B.
A attempts a new account logon using its cached pA; there is no source-level exclusion of B between the save/read and the logon.
An A refresh can rotate to pA2, while B or a third home may rotate again before A retries.
This is a source-level possible schedule, not a claim that it was recorded during the native 738 run.

narrow_patch.change: Capture GetLastError immediately after failed CreateProcessWithLogonW and before SetErrorMode(previous_error_mode). Use the saved value after restoring the error mode.
behavior_preserved: same retry count and refresh path

repair_constraints: Serializing only account provisioning leaves the credential-read-to-logon window open.
A lock only in retry_runner_spawn_once leaves direct provisioning and initial setup rotations outside the critical section.
A production coordination authority must cover all account mutations, credential loading/refresh, and successful logon; helper-process reentry must not deadlock.
A machine-wide named object needs reviewed cross-user ownership/ACL and precreation behavior. Per-home or per-process locks do not coordinate fixed machine accounts.
Sharing one test CODEX_HOME, reducing nextest concurrency or adding a test-only mutex can be a diagnostic control; it cannot establish production concurrent correctness.
Per-home account names would also require account lifecycle, firewall, desktop, migration and cleanup review; they are not a narrow credential fix.
Do not log passwords, DPAPI blobs, password hashes or password-derived fingerprints to correlate events.
